How to get involved

This ministry welcomes newcomers, and does not require you to have been here long. Ask at coffee hour, or write to the parish office and it will be passed on. Ask for Dr. Judy Marrs, Director.

The parish office — (540) 548-2665, office@ntgoc.org, Tuesday – Friday, 9:00 a.m. – 3:00 p.m.
